title: Common inversion replay request
description: Validated common contract for isolated replay. Execution additionally requires a reviewed registered source/version case, pinned code and artifact identities, source adapter and dev preflight.

source.description: Canonical source key from the reviewed source registry. Schema shape acceptance does not enable execution: the resolver must require a reviewed adapter, case, options schema and dependency contract, then freeze their identities.

version.description: Exact VSAB; case catalog resolution enforces source-specific compatibility.

engine_ref.description: Candidate revision resolved once to a full Git commit; submission must reject the template placeholder.

case_variant.description: Named reviewed catalog case, including its historical preparation state and any intentional transition changes.
